content.rationale: The success half of the status function; the gate forces the boundary to track every refusal. Its eight edges span two cells — one prose parent (nat→structured) and seven EARS parents (structured→structured, a default cell) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
